scientific_integrity: Standard pair-line basis, rooted-stem theory and algebraic counting principles are credited to earlier literature; finite computational checks supplement a complete symbolic proof, and independence is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Projective span only on Desarguesian finite geometries of prime-power order; synchronous rules. No extension to general matroids, non-Desarguesian planes, total-literal optimization, or infinite geometries.
title: Sharp logarithmic line-closure depth and direct Horn-basis inflation in finite projective geometries
